selection: Unused author length2 air-only setup, repetitions1/2 train,3 held. No error-based replacement or retuning. Same nominal author setup, not proof of unchanged physical parameters.
preprocessing: Original timestamps and angle/rate columns; no smoothing/recentering/resampling. Initial rate is first retained supplied rate. No rate-angle independence assumed.

channelScales.basis: Fixed authored-method scales before acquiring this measured setup; objective weights only, not independent sensor standard deviations

meaning: New measured method transfer test. Third repetition must not enter fitting/model/weight choice. Refusal or adverse outcome retained; no claim of externally administered blinding.
